method: Each rule is one engineering judgment: a pattern over the requirement's module and statement, the artifacts that implement it, and the test suites that prove it. Rules are applied mechanically, so a mapping is DERIVED, not hand-audited per requirement. That distinction is recorded on every row and must not be blurred — derived coverage says an implementing artifact exists, not that this exact requirement was read and confirmed.

status_definitions.traced_tested: An artifact exists that implements this topic, and that artifact is covered by a named test suite which runs in `npm run verify`. It does NOT mean this requirement was read and confirmed.
status_definitions.traced: An artifact exists that implements this topic, but no test suite is claimed for it.
status_definitions.untraced: Nothing in this repository claims to implement it. The honest default.

rules.match: estimat|takeoff|quantity|unit of measure|waste factor|bid item|line item
rules.why: The quantity and estimate engines, the versioned estimate tables, and the estimating screens.

rules.match: production rate|production method|productivity|crew production|duration|cycle time analysis
rules.why: RULE-002 and RULE-005: duration from quantity over effective production, limited by the controlling resource.
Crew composition and burdened labor, with the burden generated by the database so it cannot drift.

rules.match: equipment cost|equipment rate|rental rate|ownership cost|machine cost|attachment
rules.why: RULE-003: the equipment rate hierarchy, project quote over company over regional over seed.
RULE-004: cycle-based hauling is authoritative and a shortcut rate is labeled preliminary.
RULE-007: markup shows its basis, sequence and dollar effect; parallel and stacked genuinely differ.
RULE-010: every non-actual rate carries source, confidence and review state.
Volume states converted through the bank pivot, never directly.

Grid comparison, cross sections, stockpiles and progress to grade. Excludes imagery and point-cloud processing: there is no photogrammetry or LiDAR engine, and a table that stores a surface does not process one.

rules.match: machine control file|job file|design file|machine assignment|machine control core|file distribution
rules.why: Versioned design files by vendor and format, and which machine is running which. Excludes positioning, localization and grade control: storing a design file is not guiding a machine, and claiming otherwise would be the matrix's first lie.
Half-away-from-zero rounding with binary-error correction, and refusal of NaN rather than producing NaN money.
Projects, tasks and costs with the budget baseline traced to its estimate line.
Activities, float and critical path, with an exclusion constraint that refuses a double-booked machine.

rules.match: daily report|field report|production tracking|timecard|time entry|field operations|crew report
rules.why: Daily reports frozen once submitted; approved hours only feed productivity.
RFIs and submittals with ball-in-court and lead-time-adjusted submit-by dates.

rules.match: change order|potential change|field directive|change management|contract value control
rules.why: Change orders with cost, price and schedule impact; only executed ones count as contract value.
Notice and claim deadlines derived by the database from the contract clause and the event date.

rules.match: pay application|progress billing|aia|schedule of values|retainage|billing|invoice|accounts receivable
rules.why: AIA G702/G703 arithmetic, certified applications frozen, and the rendered PDF that reconciles to its own lines.

rules.match: job cost|cost code|committed cost|actual cost|cost tracking|wip|work in progress|over.?under billing|earned value|forecast at completion
rules.why: Committed against actual by cost code, and billed-to-date taken as the latest application rather than a sum.
AP invoices with a three-way match that blocks payment.
RFQs with leveling and a required award reason; POs carrying committed cost.
On hand less reserved, a transaction ledger, and adjustments that require a reason.
Meter-driven schedules, work orders that cannot close without a resolution, fuel exception flags.
Incidents that cannot close without a root cause; the OSHA 200,000-hour basis stated in the metric definition.
Tests carrying required against achieved; punch items that need a named verifier.
Text-layer detection, sheet classification against the National CAD Standard, versions and supersession. Excludes BIM and common-data-environment coordination, which do not exist here.
Pipeline by stage with required win/loss reasons; hit rate computed over decided bids only.

rules.match: employee master|employee record|personnel record|crew management|time.?and.?attendance|timecard|time entry|licenses and certifications|credential
rules.why: Employees gated behind hr.read, approved time entries, and credential status recomputed by the database. Excludes payroll, training, performance and workforce planning, none of which exist.
The published directory, with one rating per company per project enforced by a NULLS NOT DISTINCT constraint.

rules.match: ai |artificial intelligence|ai agent|ai governance|prompt|model registry|citation|grounding|hallucin|human approval|plan.?sheet intelligence|specification intelligence
rules.why: One governed plan analyst: draft authority, citations required, human acceptance recorded. Excludes retrieval, knowledge graph, orchestration and autonomy — none of that is built.
RLS ENABLEd and FORCEd on all 131 tables, with a security gate at the end of every migration.
Default-deny grants plus RLS as two independent controls; the gateway's decision is a pure function.
An append-only ledger nobody can rewrite, including a superuser.
Approval tiers with self-approval refused; every workflow table carries a constrained state.
Scoped, rate-limited, hashed keys; the OpenAPI spec generated from the gateway's own route table.

rules.match: connector|external system|third.?party integration|erp integration|accounting integration|telematics integration|weather
rules.why: One adapter contract with injected I/O; the NOAA adapter is testable without credentials.
Entitlement written only from signature-verified webhook state, never from a browser redirect.
A derived palette measured against WCAG contrast; semantic colors are never re-themed.
One governed definition per metric; every reporting view runs security_invoker so it cannot bypass RLS.
Company-wide and targeted notifications with per-category preferences.

rules.match: library|catalog|master data|service catalog|assembly|reference data|seed data|price book
rules.why: The three-tier scope: a company override never mutates the platform seed.
app.search runs SECURITY INVOKER, so results are permission-filtered by construction.
Deterministic PDF bytes, so the same document always renders identically and can be hashed.

verification: Separate from tracing, and separately reported. A requirement is verified only when someone has read its acceptance criteria and confirmed a specific test asserts it. That is per-requirement work; the `verification` column exists to record it, and is `none` everywhere today.

global_exclude.why: These name capability classes that do not exist in this repository. A crew engine is not AI crew recommendation; an employee table is not an onboarding workflow; a reporting view is not an executive command center. Without this, topic-word rules claim whole modules the code does not implement.
global_exclude.opt_out_why: TR-039 covers reporting and metrics, where 'forecast' and 'benchmark' name real governed metric definitions rather than an absent capability.
